decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to establish and maintain control over the game using a combination of powerful mono white control cards. By playing cards like The Eternal Wanderer, Archangel Elspeth, and Sanguine Evangelist, the player can control the board and disrupt their opponent's strategies. With defensive cards like Virtue of Loyalty and Lay Down Arms, along with removal spells like Parting Gust and Get Lost, the aim is to outlast the opponent and ultimately secure victory. The mana base is designed to support the control theme, ensuring consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. With a focus on efficient creatures like Imodane's Recruiter, Novice Inspector, and Knight-Errant of Eos, along with powerful spells like Resolute Reinforcements and Warleader's Call, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Spyglass Siren and Case of the Gateway Express provide additional disruption and card advantage. By successfully executing its aggro game plan, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The main concept of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with aggressive creatures like Preacher of the Schism and Deep-Cavern Bat, while disrupting the opponent with cards like Liliana of the Veil and Temporary Lockdown. The deck also focuses on removal with cards like Go for the Throat and Legions to Ashes to control the opponent's board. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Zoraline, Cosmos Caller and Virtue of Loyalty to provide additional card advantage and value. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board control to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells to control the board. The Orzhov Aggro archetype utilizes cards that can quickly pressure the opponent while also disrupting their strategy. By incorporating cards like Preacher of the Schism, Go for the Throat, and Zoraline, Cosmos Caller, the deck aims to maintain tempo and apply pressure to win the game quickly. Additionally, cards like Virtue of Loyalty and Virtue of Persistence provide additional support to the deck's aggressive strategy.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Phyrexian Obliterator and Mosswood Dreadknight to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to deal with opposing threats. Fabled Passage helps to fix mana while cards like Bushwhack and Restless Cottage provide additional value and flexibility. Hostile Investigator and Deep-Cavern Bat offer additional ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Liliana of the Veil and Anoint with Affliction provides extra card advantage and disruption to help secure victory.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, creatures with control abilities, and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategies and maintain board control. It also includes cards that allow the player to destroy their opponent's resources and generate card advantage. The key strategy is to outvalue the opponent by efficiently removing threats while developing a strong board presence. The deck aims to grind out the opponent with incremental advantages and win through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board of aggressive creatures while using burn spells and combat tricks to push through damage and control the opponent's board. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with quick, efficient creatures backed up by removal spells and combat tricks. The synergy between creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Monstrous Rage, along with the versatility of cards like Shock and Snakeskin Veil, allows for a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle that aims to close out games quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, utilizing the advantage of Rakdos colors to deal damage efficiently and quickly. By incorporating a mix of low-cost creatures like Deep-Cavern Bat and Flamecache Gecko with powerful burn spells like Lightning Strike and Go for the Throat, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Cavern of Souls and Blackcleave Cliffs helps to ensure consistent mana production for a fast and relentless assault.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures like Manifold Mouse and Heartfire Hero, supported by cards like Monstrous Rage and Might of the Meek to boost their power. The deck also includes some protection with Snakeskin Veil and disruption with cards like Shock. The overall strategy is to maintain a fast and aggressive pace, utilizing the creatures' abilities to quickly deal damage and overpower the opponent before they have a chance to set up their own game plan.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures and spells that can deal damage quickly, while also providing some protection and buffs to keep the pressure on. By using efficient creatures, combat tricks, and burn spells, the deck aims to finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a defense. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to win the game through relentless and swift aggression.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of creatures and removal spells to control the board. It utilizes efficient creatures like Beza, the Bounding Spring and Deep-Cavern Bat along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Legions to Ashes to keep the opponent on the back foot. Liliana of the Veil provides additional control options while Preacher of the Schism and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal offer powerful synergy with the deck's strategy. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and disrupt their game plan with targeted removal.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By maintaining a low average casting cost and including cards that buff creatures like Giant Growth, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure from the beginning of the game. The inclusion of cards like Audacity and Monstrous Rage help to push through blockers and deal substantial damage to the opponent. Overall, the deck prioritizes speed and efficiency in order to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Deep-Cavern Bat and Mosswood Dreadknight to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes removal spells such as Go for the Throat and Cut Down to control the board. The inclusion of Vraska, Betrayal's Sting and Glissa Sunslayer adds additional value and flexibility to the deck. The deck also has some disruptive elements like Duress and Tear Asunder to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and pump spells. By playing a combination of low-cost creatures and combat tricks, you can quickly build a strong board presence and put pressure on your opponent. The deck focuses on maintaining a fast pace and using efficient creatures to deal damage quickly before your opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of mana-fixing lands helps ensure you have the resources needed to cast your spells and keep the pressure on.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with creatures and then bringing them back to the battlefield with powerful reanimation spells. By utilizing a combination of self-mill effects and cards that benefit from creatures in the graveyard, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats. The key strategy is to efficiently fill up the graveyard early in the game and then use reanimation spells to bring back powerful creatures, creating a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with a powerful combo.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, backed up by removal spells and disruptive tactics to control the board. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Beza, the Bounding Spring and Preacher of the Schism, and combining them with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early on. Additional support comes from cards like Virtue of Loyalty and Virtue of Persistence, while Liliana of the Veil and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal provide extra control and power.
